False if\n81\t    80\t        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n82\t    81\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n83\t    82\t        try:\n84\t    83\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n85\t    84\t                return conn.execute(\n86\t    85\t                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n87\t    86\t                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n88\t    87\t                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n89\t    88\t                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n90\t    89\t                ).rowcount == 1\n91\t    90\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n92\t    91\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n93\t    92\t\n94\t    93\t    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n95\t    94\t        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n96\t    95\t        return rows[0] if rows else None\n97\t    96\t\n98\t    97\t    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n99\t    98\t        return self._select(\"1\", \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n100\t    99\t\n101\t   100\t    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n102\t   101\t        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n103\t   102\t\n104\t   103\t    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n105\t   104\t        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n106\t   105\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n107\t   106\t            return conn.execute(\n108\t   107\t                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n109\t   108\t                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n110\t   109\t                (status, item_id),\n111\t   110\t            ).rowcount == 1\n112\t   111\t\n113\t   112\t    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n114\t   113\t        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n115\t   114\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n116\t   115\t            return conn.execute(\n117\t   116\t                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n118\t=== app/reports.py\n119\t     1\t\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n120\t     2\t\n121\t     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\n122\t     4\tdraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\n123\t     5\tpublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\n124\t     6\tstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\n125\t     7\tDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n126\t     8\t\n127\t     9\tPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published`, so a draft\n128\t    10\tcannot leak through it.\n129\t    11\t\"\"\"\n130\t    12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n131\t    13\t\n132\t    14\timport sqlite3\n133\t    15\t\n134\t    16\tfrom app.content import ContentError, ContentTable\n135\t    17\tfrom app.users import is_director\n136\t    18\t\n137\t    19\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n138\t    20\t\n139\t    21\tcreate = _TABLE.create\n140\t    22\tget = _TABLE.get\n141\t    23\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n142\t    24\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n143\t    25\tdelete = _TABLE.delete\n144\t    26\t\n145\t    27\t\n146\t    28\tclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n147\t    29\t    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n148\t    30\t\n149\t    31\t\n150\t    32\tdef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n151\t    33\t    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` applies the same rule in its UPDATE.\"\"\"\n152\t    34\t    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n153\t    35\t\n154\t    36\t\n155\t    37\tdef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n156\t    38\t           user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n157\t    39\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`. False if there is no\n158\t    40\t    such Report; ReportLocked if it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n159\t    41\t    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user)):\n160\t    42\t        return True\n161\t    43\t    if get(report_id) is not None:\n162\t    44\t        raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can edit a published Report.\")\n163\t    45\t    return False\n164\t    46\t\n165\t    47\t\n166\t    48\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n167\t    49\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n168\t    50\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\n169\t=== app/db.py\n170\t     1\t\"\"\"SQLite access. Every table's schema lives here, so init_db() builds them all.\"\"\"\n171\t     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n172\t     3\t\n173\t     4\timport sqlite3\n174\t     5\tfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n175\t     6\tfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n176\t     7\t\n177\t     8\tfrom app import settings\n178\t     9\t\n179\t    10\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n180\t    11\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n181\t    12\t    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n182\t    13\t    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n183\t    14\t    name          TEXT    NOT NULL,\n184\t    15\t    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n185\t    16\t    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n186\t    17\t    is_active     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n187\t    18\t    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n188\t    19\t);\n189\t    20\t\n190\t    21\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_bites (\n191\t    22\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n192\t    23\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n193\t    24\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n194\t    25\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n195\t    26\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n196\t    27\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n197\t    28\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n198\t    29\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n199\t    30\t);\n200\t    31\t\n201\t    32\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reports (\n202\t    33\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n203\t    34\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n204\t    35\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- unique among Reports only; a Data Bite may share it\n205\t    36\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n206\t    37\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n207\t    38\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n208\t    39\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n209\t    40\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n210\t    41\t);\n211\t    42\t\"\"\"\n212\t    43\t\n213\t    44\t\n214\t    45\t@contextmanager\n215\t    46\tdef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n216\t    47\t    \"\"\"Open the database named by settings (read at call time, so tests can swap\n217\t    48\t    it). Commits on success, rolls back on error, always closes.\"\"\"\n218\t    49\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n219\t    50\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n220\t    51\t    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n221\t    52\t    try:\n222\t    53\t        with conn:\n223\t    54\t            yield conn\n224\t    55\t    finally:\n225\t    56\t        conn.close()\n226\t    57\t\n227\t    58\t\n228\t    59\tdef init_db() -> None:\n229\t    60\t    with connect() as conn:\n230\t    61\t        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n231\t=== app/settings.py\n232\t     1\t\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\n233\t     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n234\t     3\t\n235\t     4\timport os\n236\t     5\tfrom pathlib import Path\n237\t     6\t\n238\t     7\tROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n239\t     8\t\n240\t     9\t\n241\t    10\tdef _load_dotenv(path: Path) -> None:\n242\t    11\t    \"\"\"Read KEY=VALUE lines from .env into os.environ. Variables already set in\n243\t    12\t    the real environment win.\"\"\"\n244\t    13\t    if not path.is_file():\n245\t    14\t        return\n246\t    15\t    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():\n247\t    16\t        key, sep, value = line.partition(\"=\")\n248\t    17\t        key = key.strip()\n249\t    18\t        if not sep or not key or key.startswith(\"#\"):\n250\t    19\t            continue\n251\t    20\t        os.environ.setdefault(key, value.strip().strip(\"'\\\"\"))\n252\t    21\t\n253\t    22\t\n254\t    23\t_load_dotenv(ROOT / \".env\")\n255\t    24\t\n256\t    25\tTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\n257\t    26\tSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n258\t    27\t\n259\t    28\tSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\n260\t    29\tSECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER = SECRET_KEY in (\n261\t    30\t    \"dev-only-not-for-production\", \"change-me-to-a-long-random-string\")\n262\t    31\t# A relative CMS_DATABASE is relative to the repo, not the current directory.\n263\t    32\tDATABASE_PATH = ROOT / os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", \"cms.db\")\n264\t    33\tSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n265\t    34\t# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n266\t    35\t# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\n267\t    36\tBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n268\t=== app/publish.py\n269\t     1\t\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n270\t     2\t\n271\t     3\tT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\n272\t     4\trender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n273\t     5\t\n274\t     6\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n275\t     7\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n276\t     8\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n277\t     9\t\"\"\"\n278\t    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n279\t    11\t\n280\t    12\timport shutil\n281\t    13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n282\t    14\t\n283\t    15\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n284\t    16\t\n285\t    17\tfrom app import settings\n286\t    18\t\n287\t    19\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n288\t    20\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n289\t    21\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n290\t    22\theader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n291\t    23\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n292\t    24\t\"\"\"\n293\t    25\t\n294\t    26\t\n295\t    27\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n296\t    28\t    return Environment(\n297\t    29\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n298\t    30\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n299\t    31\t    )\n300\t    32\t\n301\t    33\t\n302\t    34\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n303\t    35\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n304\t    36\t    if out.exists():\n305\t    37\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n306\t    38\t    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n307\t    39\t    env = environment()\n308\t    40\t    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n309\t    41\t    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n310\t    42\t        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n311\t    43\t            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n312\t    44\t            home_path=\"index.html\",\n313\t    45\t        )\n314\t    46\t    )\n315\t    47\t    return out\n316\t=== app/routes/reports.py\n317\t     1\t\"\"\"Reports in the admin console. Any signed-in user may list Reports, create a\n318\t     2\tdraft, and edit a draft. Editing a published Report, and publishing,\n319\t     3\tunpublishing, or deleting any Report, is Director only.\"\"\"\n320\t     4\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n321\t     5\t\n322\t     6\timport sqlite3\n323\t     7\t\n324\t     8\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\n325\t     9\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n326\t    10\t\n327\t    11\tfrom app import reports\n328\t    12\tfrom app.auth import current_user, require_csrf, require_director\n329\t    13\tfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS, ContentError\n330\t    14\tfrom app.templating import templates\n331\t    15\t\n332\t    16\trouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/reports\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n333\t    17\t\n334\t    18\t\n335\t    19\tdef _list_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: str | None = None,\n336\t    20\t               form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n337\t    21\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n338\t    22\t        request, \"admin/reports.html\",\n339\t    23\t        {\"title\": \"Reports\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n340\t    24\t         \"reports\": reports.list_all(), \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n341\t    25\t         \"error\": error, \"form\": form or {}},\n342\t    26\t        status_code=status_code,\n343\t    27\t    )\n344\t    28\t\n345\t    29\t\n346\t    30\t@router.get(\"\")\n347\t    31\tdef list_reports(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n348\t    32\t    return _list_page(request, user)\n349\t    33\t\n350\t    34\t\n351\t    35\t@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n352\t    36\tdef create_report(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n353\t    37\t                  slug: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n354\t    38\t    try:\n355\t    39\t        reports.create(title, slug, body, user[\"id\"])\n356\t    40\t    except ContentError as exc:\n357\t    41\t        return _list_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n358\t    42\t                          form={\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body})\n359\t    43\t    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n360\t    44\t\n361\t    45\t\n362\t    46\tdef _edit_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, report: sqlite3.Row, *,\n363\t    47\t               error: str | None = None, form: dict | None = None,\n364\t    48\t               status_code: int = 200):\n365\t    49\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n366\t    50\t        request, \"admin/report_edit.html\",\n367\t    51\t        {\"title\": \"Edit Report\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n368\t    52\t         \"report\": report, \"can_edit\": reports.can_edit(report, user),\n369\t    53\t         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS, \"error\": error, \"form\": form or report},\n370\t    54\t        status_code=status_code,\n371\t    55\t    )\n372\t    56\t\n373\t    57\t\n374\t    58\tdef _get_or_404(report_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n375\t    59\t    report = reports.get(report_id)\n376\t    60\t    if report is None:\n377\t    61\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n378\t    62\t    return report\n379\t    63\t\n380\t    64\t\n381\t    65\t@router.get(\"/{report_id}\")\n382\t    66\tdef edit_form(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n383\t    67\t    return _edit_page(request, user, _get_or_404(report_id))\n384\t    68\t\n385\t    69\t\n386\t    70\t@router.post(\"/{report_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n387\t    71\tdef edit_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n388\t    72\t                title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n389\t    73\t    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n390\t    74\t    # Permission before validation: a locked Report is 403 whatever was sent.\n391\t    75\t    if not reports.can_edit(report, user):\n392\t    76\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Only the Director can edit a published Report.\")\n393\t    77\t    try:\n394\t    78\t        if not reports.update(report_id, title, slug, body, user=user):\n395\t    79\t            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n396\t    80\t    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n397\t    81\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n398\t    82\t    except ContentError as exc:\n399\t    83\t        return _edit_page(request, user, report, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n400\t    84\t                          form={\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body})\n401\t    85\t    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n402\t    86\t\n403\t    87\t\n404\t    88\tdef _set_status(report_id: int, status: str):\n405\t    89\t    if not reports.set_status(report_id, status):\n406\t    90\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n407\t    91\t    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n408\t    92\t\n409\t    93\t\n410\t    94\t@router.post(\"/{report_id}/publish\",\n411\t    95\t             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\n412\t    96\tdef publish(report_id: int):\n413\t    97\t    return _set_status(report_id, \"published\")\n414\t    98\t\n415\t    99\t\n416\t   100\t@router.post(\"/{report_id}/unpublish\",\n417\t   101\t             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\n418\t   102\tdef unpublish(report_id: int):\n419\t   103\t    return _set_status(report_id, \"draft\")\n420\t   104\t\n421\t   105\t\n422\t   106\t@router.post(\"/{report_id}/delete\",\n423\t   107\t             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\n424\t   108\tdef delete(report_id: int):\n425\t   109\t    if not reports.delete(report_id):\n426\t   110\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n427\t   111\t    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n428\t=== app/main.py\n429\t     1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n430\t     2\t\n431\t     3\tThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public preview\n432\t     4\tat /. Routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included here.\n433\t     5\tKeep this file small.\n434\t     6\t\"\"\"\n435\t     7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n436\t     8\t\n437\t     9\timport sys\n438\t    10\tfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n439\t    11\t\n440\t    12\tfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\n441\t    13\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n442\t    14\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n443\t    15\t\n444\t    16\tfrom app import db, settings\n445\t    17\tfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\n446\t    18\tfrom app.data_bites import list_published as published_data_bites\n447\t    19\tfrom app.reports import list_published as published_reports\n448\t    20\tfrom app.routes import admin, auth, data_bites, reports, users\n449\t    21\tfrom app.templating import templates\n450\t    22\t\n451\t    23\tSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\n452\t    24\tALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n453\t    25\t\n454\t    26\t\n455\t    27\t@asynccontextmanager\n456\t    28\tasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n457\t    29\t    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n458\t    30\t    db.init_db()\n459\t    31\t    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n460\t    32\t        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n461\t    33\t              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n462\t    34\t              file=sys.stderr)\n463\t    35\t    yield\n464\t    36\t\n465\t    37\t\n466\t    38\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n467\t    39\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n468\t    40\t    app.add_middleware(\n469\t    41\t        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n470\t    42\t        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n471\t    43\t    )\n472\t    44\t\n473\t    45\t    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n474\t    46\t    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n475\t    47\t        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n476\t    48\t\n477\t    49\t    @app.get(\"/\")\n478\t    50\t    def public_home(request: Request):\n479\t    51\t        # Titles only: the public pages (and links to them) arrive with the\n480\t    52\t        # public-site ticket, T07.\n481\t    53\t        data_bite_items = [{\"title\": b[\"title\"]} for b in published_data_bites()]\n482\t    54\t        report_items = [{\"title\": r[\"title\"]} for r in published_reports()]\n483\t    55\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n484\t    56\t            request, \"public/home.html\",\n485\t    57\t            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": data_bite_items,\n486\t    58\t             \"reports\": report_items},\n487\t    59\t        )\n488\t    60\t\n489\t    61\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n490\t    62\t    app.include_router(admin.router)\n491\t    63\t    app.include_router(users.router)\n492\t    64\t    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n493\t    65\t    app.include_router(reports.router)\n494\t    66\t\n495\t    67\t    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n496\t    68\t    # method. It holds only the user's id and a CSRF token. app/content.py\n     1\t\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\n     2\tvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n     3\t\n     4\tEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\n     5\tData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\n     6\texports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\n     7\tmodule and routes, not here.\n     8\t\"\"\"\n     9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    10\t\n    11\timport re\n    12\timport sqlite3\n    13\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom app import db\n    16\t\n    17\tSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n    18\t_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n    19\t\n    20\t\n    21\tclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    22\t    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n    23\t\n    24\t\n    25\tclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    26\t    pass\n    27\t\n    28\t\n    29\tdef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    30\t    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    31\t    if not title:\n    32\t        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    33\t    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n    34\t        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n    35\t                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    36\t    if not body.strip():\n    37\t        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    38\t    return title, slug, body\n    39\t\n    40\t\n    41\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    42\tclass ContentTable:\n    43\t    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    44\t    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    45\t    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    46\t    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n    47\t\n    48\t    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    49\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n    50\t            return conn.execute(\n    51\t                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n    52\t                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n    53\t                params,\n    54\t            ).fetchall()\n    55\t\n    56\t    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n    57\t        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n    58\t        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n    59\t            raise exc\n    60\t        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n    61\t\n    62\t    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    63\t        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n    64\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n    65\t        try:\n    66\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n    67\t                cursor = conn.execute(\n    68\t                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n    69\t                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n    70\t                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n    71\t                )\n    72\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n    73\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n    74\t        return cursor.lastrowid\n    75\t\n    76\t    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n    77\t               drafts_only: bool = False) -> bool:\n    78\t        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n    79\t        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n    80\t        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n    81\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n    82\t        try:\n    83\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n    84\t                return conn.execute(\n    85\t                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n    86\t                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n    87\t                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n    88\t                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n    89\t                ).rowcount == 1\n    90\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n    91\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n    92\t\n    93\t    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    94\t        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n    95\t        return rows[0] if rows else None\n    96\t\n    97\t    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    98\t        return self._select(\"1\", \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n    99\t\n   100\t    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n   101\t        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n   102\t\n   103\t    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n   104\t        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n   105\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n   106\t            return conn.execute(\n   107\t                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n   108\t                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n   109\t                (status, item_id),\n   110\t            ).rowcount == 1\n   111\t\n   112\t    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n   113\t        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n   114\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n   115\t            return conn.execute(\n   116\t                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n=== app/reports.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n     2\t\n     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\n     4\tdraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\n     5\tpublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\n     6\tstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\n     7\tDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n     8\t\n     9\tPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published`, so a draft\n    10\tcannot leak through it.\n    11\t\"\"\"\n    12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    13\t\n    14\timport sqlite3\n    15\t\n    16\tfrom app.content import ContentError, ContentTable\n    17\tfrom app.users import is_director\n    18\t\n    19\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n    20\t\n    21\tcreate = _TABLE.create\n    22\tget = _TABLE.get\n    23\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n    24\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n    25\tdelete = _TABLE.delete\n    26\t\n    27\t\n    28\tclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    29\t    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    30\t\n    31\t\n    32\tdef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    33\t    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` applies the same rule in its UPDATE.\"\"\"\n    34\t    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n    35\t\n    36\t\n    37\tdef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n    38\t           user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    39\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`. False if there is no\n    40\t    such Report; ReportLocked if it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    41\t    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user)):\n    42\t        return True\n    43\t    if get(report_id) is not None:\n    44\t        raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can edit a published Report.\")\n    45\t    return False\n    46\t\n    47\t\n    48\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    49\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    50\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\n=== app/db.py\n     1\t\"\"\"SQLite access. Every table's schema lives here, so init_db() builds them all.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\timport sqlite3\n     5\tfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n     6\tfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n     7\t\n     8\tfrom app import settings\n     9\t\n    10\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n    11\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    12\t    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    13\t    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    14\t    name          TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    15\t    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    16\t    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    17\t    is_active     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    18\t    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n    19\t);\n    20\t\n    21\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_bites (\n    22\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    23\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    24\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    25\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n    26\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    27\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    28\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    29\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n    30\t);\n    31\t\n    32\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reports (\n    33\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    34\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    35\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- unique among Reports only; a Data Bite may share it\n    36\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n    37\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    38\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    39\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    40\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n    41\t);\n    42\t\"\"\"\n    43\t\n    44\t\n    45\t@contextmanager\n    46\tdef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    47\t    \"\"\"Open the database named by settings (read at call time, so tests can swap\n    48\t    it). Commits on success, rolls back on error, always closes.\"\"\"\n    49\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    50\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    51\t    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    52\t    try:\n    53\t        with conn:\n    54\t            yield conn\n    55\t    finally:\n    56\t        conn.close()\n    57\t\n    58\t\n    59\tdef init_db() -> None:\n    60\t    with connect() as conn:\n    61\t        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n=== app/settings.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\timport os\n     5\tfrom pathlib import Path\n     6\t\n     7\tROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n     8\t\n     9\t\n    10\tdef _load_dotenv(path: Path) -> None:\n    11\t    \"\"\"Read KEY=VALUE lines from .env into os.environ. Variables already set in\n    12\t    the real environment win.\"\"\"\n    13\t    if not path.is_file():\n    14\t        return\n    15\t    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():\n    16\t        key, sep, value = line.partition(\"=\")\n    17\t        key = key.strip()\n    18\t        if not sep or not key or key.startswith(\"#\"):\n    19\t            continue\n    20\t        os.environ.setdefault(key, value.strip().strip(\"'\\\"\"))\n    21\t\n    22\t\n    23\t_load_dotenv(ROOT / \".env\")\n    24\t\n    25\tTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\n    26\tSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n    27\t\n    28\tSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\n    29\tSECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER = SECRET_KEY in (\n    30\t    \"dev-only-not-for-production\", \"change-me-to-a-long-random-string\")\n    31\t# A relative CMS_DATABASE is relative to the repo, not the current directory.\n    32\tDATABASE_PATH = ROOT / os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", \"cms.db\")\n    33\tSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n    34\t# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n    35\t# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\n    36\tBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n=== app/publish.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n     2\t\n     3\tT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\n     4\trender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n     5\t\n     6\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n     7\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     8\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     9\t\"\"\"\n    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    11\t\n    12\timport shutil\n    13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n    16\t\n    17\tfrom app import settings\n    18\t\n    19\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n    20\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n    21\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n    22\theader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n    23\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n    24\t\"\"\"\n    25\t\n    26\t\n    27\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n    28\t    return Environment(\n    29\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n    30\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    31\t    )\n    32\t\n    33\t\n    34\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    35\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n    36\t    if out.exists():\n    37\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    38\t    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    39\t    env = environment()\n    40\t    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    41\t    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n    42\t        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n    43\t            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n    44\t            home_path=\"index.html\",\n    45\t        )\n    46\t    )\n    47\t    return out\n=== app/routes/reports.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Reports in the admin console. Any signed-in user may list Reports, create a\n     2\tdraft, and edit a draft. Editing a published Report, and publishing,\n     3\tunpublishing, or deleting any Report, is Director only.\"\"\"\n     4\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     5\t\n     6\timport sqlite3\n     7\t\n     8\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\n     9\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n    10\t\n    11\tfrom app import reports\n    12\tfrom app.auth import current_user, require_csrf, require_director\n    13\tfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS, ContentError\n    14\tfrom app.templating import templates\n    15\t\n    16\trouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/reports\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n    17\t\n    18\t\n    19\tdef _list_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: str | None = None,\n    20\t               form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    21\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    22\t        request, \"admin/reports.html\",\n    23\t        {\"title\": \"Reports\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n    24\t         \"reports\": reports.list_all(), \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n    25\t         \"error\": error, \"form\": form or {}},\n    26\t        status_code=status_code,\n    27\t    )\n    28\t\n    29\t\n    30\t@router.get(\"\")\n    31\tdef list_reports(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    32\t    return _list_page(request, user)\n    33\t\n    34\t\n    35\t@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n    36\tdef create_report(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n    37\t                  slug: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    38\t    try:\n    39\t        reports.create(title, slug, body, user[\"id\"])\n    40\t    except ContentError as exc:\n    41\t        return _list_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n    42\t                          form={\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body})\n    43\t    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n    44\t\n    45\t\n    46\tdef _edit_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, report: sqlite3.Row, *,\n    47\t               error: str | None = None, form: dict | None = None,\n    48\t               status_code: int = 200):\n    49\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    50\t        request, \"admin/report_edit.html\",\n    51\t        {\"title\": \"Edit Report\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n    52\t         \"report\": report, \"can_edit\": reports.can_edit(report, user),\n    53\t         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS, \"error\": error, \"form\": form or report},\n    54\t        status_code=status_code,\n    55\t    )\n    56\t\n    57\t\n    58\tdef _get_or_404(report_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    59\t    report = reports.get(report_id)\n    60\t    if report is None:\n    61\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    62\t    return report\n    63\t\n    64\t\n    65\t@router.get(\"/{report_id}\")\n    66\tdef edit_form(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    67\t    return _edit_page(request, user, _get_or_404(report_id))\n    68\t\n    69\t\n    70\t@router.post(\"/{report_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\n    71\tdef edit_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n    72\t                title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    73\t    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    74\t    # Permission before validation: a locked Report is 403 whatever was sent.\n    75\t    if not reports.can_edit(report, user):\n    76\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Only the Director can edit a published Report.\")\n    77\t    try:\n    78\t        if not reports.update(report_id, title, slug, body, user=user):\n    79\t            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    80\t    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n    81\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    82\t    except ContentError as exc:\n    83\t        return _edit_page(request, user, report, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n    84\t                          form={\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body})\n    85\t    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n    86\t\n    87\t\n    88\tdef _set_status(report_id: int, status: str):\n    89\t    if not reports.set_status(report_id, status):\n    90\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    91\t    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n    92\t\n    93\t\n    94\t@router.post(\"/{report_id}/publish\",\n    95\t             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\n    96\tdef publish(report_id: int):\n    97\t    return _set_status(report_id, \"published\")\n    98\t\n    99\t\n   100\t@router.post(\"/{report_id}/unpublish\",\n   101\t             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\n   102\tdef unpublish(report_id: int):\n   103\t    return _set_status(report_id, \"draft\")\n   104\t\n   105\t\n   106\t@router.post(\"/{report_id}/delete\",\n   107\t             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\n   108\tdef delete(report_id: int):\n   109\t    if not reports.delete(report_id):\n   110\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n   111\t    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n=== app/main.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n     2\t\n     3\tThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public preview\n     4\tat /. Routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included here.\n     5\tKeep this file small.\n     6\t\"\"\"\n     7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     8\t\n     9\timport sys\n    10\tfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n    11\t\n    12\tfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\n    13\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n    14\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n    15\t\n    16\tfrom app import db, settings\n    17\tfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\n    18\tfrom app.data_bites import list_published as published_data_bites\n    19\tfrom app.reports import list_published as published_reports\n    20\tfrom app.routes import admin, auth, data_bites, reports, users\n    21\tfrom app.templating import templates\n    22\t\n    23\tSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\n    24\tALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n    25\t\n    26\t\n    27\t@asynccontextmanager\n    28\tasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    29\t    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n    30\t    db.init_db()\n    31\t    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n    32\t        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n    33\t              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n    34\t              file=sys.stderr)\n    35\t    yield\n    36\t\n    37\t\n    38\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    39\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n    40\t    app.add_middleware(\n    41\t        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n    42\t        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n    43\t    )\n    44\t\n    45\t    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    46\t    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n    47\t        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    48\t\n    49\t    @app.get(\"/\")\n    50\t    def public_home(request: Request):\n    51\t        # Titles only: the public pages (and links to them) arrive with the\n    52\t        # public-site ticket, T07.\n    53\t        data_bite_items = [{\"title\": b[\"title\"]} for b in published_data_bites()]\n    54\t        report_items = [{\"title\": r[\"title\"]} for r in published_reports()]\n    55\t        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n    56\t            request, \"public/home.html\",\n    57\t            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": data_bite_items,\n    58\t             \"reports\": report_items},\n    59\t        )\n    60\t\n    61\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    62\t    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    63\t    app.include_router(users.router)\n    64\t    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n    65\t    app.include_router(reports.router)\n    66\t\n    67\t    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n    68\t    # method. The user is\n     5\tre-loaded from the database on every protected request, so deactivating an\n     6\taccount ends its sessions at once.\n     7\t\"\"\"\n     8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     9\t\n    10\timport secrets\n    11\timport sqlite3\n    12\t\n    13\tfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom app import users\n    16\t\n    17\t\n    18\tclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    19\t    \"\"\"Raised by current_user; main.py turns it into a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n    20\t\n    21\t\n    22\tdef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    23\t    \"\"\"Dependency: the logged-in, still-active user, or LoginRequired.\"\"\"\n    24\t    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    25\t    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None\n    26\t    if user is None:\n    27\t        request.session.clear()\n    28\t        raise LoginRequired\n    29\t    return user\n    30\t\n    31\t\n    32\tdef require_director(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    33\t    \"\"\"Dependency: current_user, but 403 unless they are a Director.\"\"\"\n    34\t    if not users.is_director(user):\n    35\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Directors only.\")\n    36\t    return user\n    37\t\n    38\t\n    39\tdef log_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    40\t    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on login, so a pre-login cookie planted\n    41\t    # by someone else never becomes an authenticated one.\n    42\t    request.session.clear()\n    43\t    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    44\t    csrf_token(request)\n    45\t\n    46\t\n    47\tdef log_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    48\t    request.session.clear()\n    49\t\n    50\t\n    51\tdef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    52\t    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Templates call this.\"\"\"\n    53\t    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    54\t    if token is None:\n    55\t        token = request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    56\t    return token\n    57\t\n    58\t\n    59\tasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    60\t    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing POST: the form's csrf_token must\n    61\t    match the session's.\"\"\"\n    62\t    form = await request.form()\n    63\t    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    64\t    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    65\t    if not (isinstance(submitted, str) and expected\n    66\t            and secrets.compare_digest(submitted, expected)):\n    67\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n=== templates/admin/report_edit.html\n     1\t{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n     2\t{% block content %}\n     3\t  <p><a href=\"/admin/reports\">All Reports</a></p>\n     4\t  <h1>{{ \"Edit Report\" if can_edit else report.title }}</h1>\n     5\t  <p>{{ status_labels[report.status] }}. annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n# Security checklist\n\nWhat must be true before you submit. *How* to make each one true is your work —\nthat is the point of the tickets.\n\n| # | Must be true | How the grader checks it |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Stored passwords are argon2 hashes | Reads the seeded database and looks at the stored value |\n| 2 | Wrong passwords are refused, and the message does not reveal whether the account exists | Tries a bad password |\n| 3 | Every state-changing form (POST) carries a CSRF token and rejects a request without one | Replays each POST with the token removed |\n| 4 | An editor cannot reach any admin-only route | Logs in as the seeded editor and requests each admin route |\n| 5 | An anonymous visitor is redirected to login, never shown admin content | Requests admin routes with no session |\n| 6 | A deactivated user cannot log in | Deactivates the seeded editor, then tries to log in |\n| 7 | User-written Markdown cannot inject scripts | Saves a post containing `<script>` and an `onerror=` attribute, publishes, and checks both the preview and the export |\n| 8 | Drafts never appear in `site/` or on the public site | Publishes with a draft present and searches the output |\n| 9 | No secrets, databases, or `.env` files in git history | Greps the full history |\n| 10 | Access control is enforced in code, not by hiding links | Requests admin URLs directly rather than clicking |\n\nRule of thumb: if the only thing stopping an editor from reaching a page is that\nthe link is hidden, it is not stopping anyone.\n4373158 docs: {"parentUuid":"d4d698c5-fa01-4d8d-a8e0-d91009775deb","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"6e7e4a11-4643-4323-a25e-b33228f6212a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/davelleat/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\"\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. {"parentUuid":"96109f6d-8644-4741-b73f-33154c91226a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfWdZEpmE3pgUQUjhsQNv","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WswXVunG7hmnw7DrojUtGu","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t05_report_files.py","content":"\"\"\"T05: Report file attachment (issue #6).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, report_id\n\n# A minimal, well-formed PDF: the header and the end-of-file marker are what\n# make it a PDF, whatever the upload's filename says.\nPDF = (b\"%PDF-1.4\\n1 0 obj<</Type/Catalog/Pages 2 0 R>>endobj\\n\"\n       b\"2 0 obj<</Type/Pages/Kids[]/Count 0>>endobj\\n\"\n       b\"trailer<</Root 1 0 R>>\\n%%EOF\\n\")\n\n\ndef post_with_file(c: TestClient, path: str, data: dict, file=None, *, with_csrf=True):\n    \"\"\"POST a multipart admin form. `file` is (filename, bytes, content type);\n    None sends the form with no file chosen, as a browser does.\"\"\"\n    if with_csrf:\n        data = {**data, \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n    file = file or (\"\", b\"\", \"application/octet-stream\")\n    return c.post(path, data=data, files={\"file\": file}, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef pdf(name: str = \"factbook-2026.pdf\", content: bytes = PDF):\n    return (name, content, \"application/pdf\")\n\n\ndef test_analyst_attaches_a_pdf_when_creating_a_draft_report(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_with_file(analyst, \"/admin/reports\", REPORT, pdf())\n    assert The file is\nstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published`, so a draft\ncannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sqlite3\nimport tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.content import ContentError, ContentTable\nfrom app.uploads import Pdf\nfrom app.users import is_director\n''')\ns=s.replace('''set_status = _TABLE.set_status\ndelete = _TABLE.delete\n''','''set_status = _TABLE.set_status\n''')\ns=s.replace('''def list_published()''','''def file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef _write_atomically(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace `path` in one step, so a failed write never leaves half a file.\"\"\"\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=\".part\")\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"wb\") as f:\n            f.write(data)\n        os.replace(tmp, path)\n    except BaseException:\n        Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n        raise\n\n\ndef _change_file(report_id: int, pdf: Pdf | None, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Attach `pdf`, or remove the file when it is None, under the lockdown\n    rule. The disk change happens inside the transaction that records it, so\n    a failed write rolls the row back, and a locked Report's file is never\n    touched.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        changed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n            (pdf.name if pdf else None, report_id, not is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n        if changed and pdf:\n            _write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n        elif changed:\n            file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    if changed:\n        return True\n    if get(report_id) is not None:\n        raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can change a published Report's file.\")\n    return False\n\n\ndef attach_file(report_id: int, pdf: Pdf, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Attach or replace the Report's file on behalf of `user`. False if there\n    is no such Report; ReportLocked if it is published and `user` is not a\n    Director.\"\"\"\n    return _change_file(report_id, pdf, user)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file, as attach_file.\"\"\"\n    return _change_file(report_id, None, user)\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report and its file. False if there is no such Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published()''')\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF","description":"Add file attach/remove/delete to reports module"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1182,"cache_read_input_tokens":92058,"output_tokens":1543,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":123},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1182,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1543,"cache_read_input_tokens":92058,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1182,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1182},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01EYiPVWZYemUJkhKSHNzL7o":{"command":"cd /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && python3 - <<'EOF'\np='app/reports.py'; s=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''Public-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published`, so a draft\ncannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app.content import ContentError, ContentTable\nfrom app.users import is_director\n''','''A Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). the edit form, now carrying a file","+    (\"POST\", \"/admin/reports\"),       # the create form, likewise","+]","+","+","+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path\", FILE_ROUTES)","+def test_anonymous_visitor_is_redirected_from_every_file_route(client, client_as, method, path):","+    rid = draft_with_file(client_as(\"editor\"))","+    files = {\"file\": pdf(\"tampered.pdf\", REVISED)} if method == \"POST\" else None","+    response = client.request(method, path.format(id=rid),","+                              data={**REPORT, \"slug\": \"new-slug\"} if files else None,","+                              files=files, follow_redirects=False)","+    assert response.status_code in (302, 303, 307)","+    assert response.headers[\"location\"].endswith(\"/login\")","+    assert reports_file(rid).read_bytes() == PDF","+","+","+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path\", [r for r in FILE_ROUTES if r[0] == \"POST\"])","+def test_file_posts_without_csrf_token_are_rejected(client_as, method, path):","+    director = client_as(\"admin\")","+    rid = draft_with_file(director)","+    director.get(\"/admin\")  # the session has a token; the POST just omits it","+    response = post_with_file(director, path.format(id=rid), {**REPORT, \"slug\": \"new-slug\"},","+                              pdf(\"tampered.pdf\", REVISED), with_csrf=False)","+    assert response.status_code == 403","+    assert reports_file(rid).read_bytes() == PDF","+    assert \"new-slug\" not in director.get(\"/admin/reports\").text","+","+","+def test_an_existing_database_gains_the_file_column(tmp_path, monkeypatch, client_as):","+    \"\"\"A cms.db made before T05 has a reports table without file_name.\"\"\"","+    old = tmp_path / \"old.db\"","+    with sqlite3.connect(old) as conn:","+        conn.executescript(db.SCHEMA.replace(","+            \",\\n    file_name  TEXT    -- the attached PDF's sanitized name for display; NULL if none\", \"\"))","+        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO users (email, name, role, password_hash)\"","+                     \" VALUES ('x@example.test', 'X', 'admin', 'x')\")","+        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO reports (title, slug, body, author_id)\"","+                     \" VALUES ('Old CDS', 'old-cds', 'Body.', 1)\")","+        assert \"file_name\" not in {r[1] for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA table_info(reports)\")}","+    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", old)","+    db.init_db()","+    for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():","+        users.create_user(user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"], role)","+","+    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")","+    rid = report_id(analyst, \"old-cds\")","+    assert \"Attached file:\\n    none\" in analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text","+    assert post_with_file(analyst, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\",","+                          {\"title\": \"Old CDS\", \"slug\": \"old-cds\", \"body\": \"Body.\"},","+                          pdf()).status_code == 303","+    assert analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}/file\").content == PDF","+    db.init_db()  # running it again is harmless"]}]}],"moreFiles":0,"changedFiles":["/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t05_report_files.py"]}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b7abdb47-3207-4cbd-909a-f512153d9f77","session_id":"fc138a42-1eee-4017-bff2-c6a77302f820","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"54df4e4b-7cf3-435a-81bf-5bb85e4c7757","version":"2.1.284","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"ceb8b75c-c1f3-4ff7-9e1b-37ef737f324a","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"6e7e4a11-4643-4323-a25e-b33228f6212a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/davelleat/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review uncommitted working-tree changes since HEAD (4373158) for ticket T05, GitHub issue #6 (spec #1). Ignore notes/usage-ledger.csv and docs/transcripts/ (not part of the ticket)."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"65653590-4381-4f41-bf24-0d6083ada8e3","timestamp":"2026-09-28T22:35:55.872Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01HDNEr3MxwT3bWkF7Cf7i4r","session_id":"fc138a42-1eee-4017-bff2-c6a77302f820","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"54df4e4b-7cf3-435a-81bf-5bb85e4c7757","version":"2.1.284","gitBranch":"main"}

The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>I found no hard violations of the documented standards. There are two small correctness gaps, and the rest are judgement calls.\n\n**Hard violations**\n\n- **CLAUDE.md \"Hard constraints\":** none found.\n  - Every new POST form carries `csrf_token`, and the new remove-file form does too.\n  - Uploaded files are stored under `settings.UPLOADS`, outside `site/`, and `uploads/` is gitignored.\n  - The new `/admin/...` links are absolute, but they are admin-only templates, not published HTML, so the relative-paths rule doesn't apply.\n- **No new dependencies:** `UploadFile` uses the existing `python-multipart`.\n- **CONTEXT.md vocabulary:** none of the words to avoid appear.\n\n**Correctness bugs**\n\n1. **`app/routes/reports.py` `download_file`:** if `file_name` is set but the file on disk is missing, `FileResponse` raises and the user gets a 500 instead of a 404. That can happen after a wiped or copied `uploads/`. It can also happen in `_change_file`, which unlinks the file before the transaction commits, so a failed commit leaves the row pointing at nothing.\n2. **`create_report` / `edit_report`:** `reports.create`/`update` and `attach_file` run as two separate transactions. If the file write fails with `OSError`, the Report or body edit is saved without its file, and the user sees a 500.\n3. **Size cap (minor):** `require_csrf` calls `request.form()`, which buffers the whole upload before the CSRF check or the `MAX_BYTES` check runs. So the 20 MB cap limits what is stored, not what is received. This is acceptable for a local-only admin console.\n\n**Smells (all judgement calls)**\n\n- **Duplicated Code:**\n  - `_change_file`'s tail (`if get(report_id) is not None: raise ReportLocked(...)`) repeats the same shape in `update`.\n  - The routes `edit_report` and `remove_file` repeat the `can_edit` → 403 check and the `except reports.ReportLocked` block, and the message \"Only the Director can change a published Report's file.\" is written out in both `reports.py` and the routes.\n  - In the tests, `reports_file(rid)` re-implements `reports.file_path`; it should just call it.\n- **Divergent Change / leaky partial:** `_content_fields.html` is shared with Data Bites but now reads Report-only names (`report.file_name`, `max_file_mb`). Passing a `file_label` from the caller would keep the partial type-neutral.\n- **Feature Envy / layering:** `reports.py` previously left all SQL to `ContentTable`. It now opens `db.connect()` and writes raw `UPDATE reports ...` itself.\n- **Mysterious Name:** the SQL `(status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)` is fed `not is_director(user)`, a double negative. Passing `is_director(user)` with `OR ?` would read directly.\n- **Middle Man:** `attach_file` and `remove_file` only delegate to `_change_file`. This is defensible as a named public API.\n- **Speculative Generality (mild):** the `ADDED_COLUMNS` migration list exists for a single column. It is cheap and documented, so keeping it is fine.\n- **Brittle test:** `test_an_existing_database_gains_the_file_column` rebuilds the old schema by string-replacing the exact `file_name` line, comment included, in `db.SCHEMA`. Any edit to that comment silently breaks the test. A hard-coded pre-T05 `CREATE TABLE` would be sturdier.\n\n**House style:** docstrings, comment density and naming match `app/content.py` and `test_t04_reports.py`. `uploads.py` fits in well.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>59402</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>4</tool_uses><duration_ms>44024</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>**Spec review: T05 (#6), uncommitted diff on top of 4373158**\n\nThe T05 tests pass (32/32). The full suite has 14 failures, all in `tests/test_ctx_guard.py` and `tests/test_usage_report.py`, which this diff does not touch.\n\n**(a) Missing or partial**\n\n1. Two export tests can't fail yet. The spec's Draft-leak test says: *\"publish with a draft Data Bite and a draft Report (with its file) present, assert both are absent from `site/`\"*. The ticket asks: *\"A Report with no attached file still works correctly end-to-end\"*. But `render_site` in `app/publish.py` still writes only `index.html` and `style.css`. So `test_a_draft_reports_file_never_appears_in_public_output` can't catch a leak, and `test_a_report_with_no_file_works_end_to_end` only checks that `index.html` exists. Real export belongs to T08, so this isn't a T05 gap. T08 should tighten both tests: assert `reports/&lt;slug&gt;.html` exists and that `reports/files/` holds no draft file. The draft-leak test also has no draft Data Bite, but that part of the spec test is T03/T08's.\n\nEvery other ticket criterion is covered by code and tests: role and state rules, content sniffing, filename sanitizing (the storage path uses the id only, which is stronger than asked), the size cap with a clear error, and the lockdown.\n\n**(b) Not asked for (scope creep)**\n\n1. `GET /admin/reports/{id}/file` is a new admin download route, open to any signed-in user in any Report state. No story asks for it (story 24's download is public, which is T07/T08). It's low risk and useful for checking uploads, but it wasn't requested.\n2. `ADDED_COLUMNS` in `app/db.py` adds an ad-hoc migration mechanism. You can defend it under story 28 (*\"content, files, and sessions … survive a server restart\"*), since an existing `cms.db` keeps working, but it's new infrastructure beyond the ticket.\n3. Deleting a Report now also deletes its file. That's implied by story 18, so it's fine.\n\n**(c) Implemented, but looks wrong**\n\n1. Edits can half-save. The ticket says *\"Attaching, replacing, or removing the file follows the same draft/publish lockdown as the Report's Markdown body\"*. In `edit_report`, `reports.update(...)` commits the body before `attach_file(...)` runs in a separate transaction. If the Director publishes in between, the Analyst gets a 403 but the body edit has already been saved. A disk error at that point also leaves the body saved without the file. `create_report` has the same gap: a failed write leaves a draft with no file and returns a 500. The lockdown is never broken, but the save isn't all-or-nothing.\n2. `download_file` returns a 500, not a 404, when `file_name` is set but the file is missing from disk (for example, `uploads/` wiped while `cms.db` kept). `FileResponse` raises on a missing path.\n3. The size cap is checked after `python-multipart` has already received the whole upload into a temporary file. Oversized files are never stored, which meets story 27 (*\"a size cap, so the upload path can't be used to smuggle … oversized files\"*), but nothing limits the request body size.\n4. The PDF check requires `%PDF-` at byte 0 and `%%EOF` somewhere in the last 1024 bytes. Real PDFs with a few leading bytes or a larger trailer would be rejected. This rarely happens but is worth knowing.\n\nFiles reviewed:\n- `/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/uploads.py`\n- `/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/reports.py`\n- `/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/reports.py`\n- `/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/db.py`\n- `/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/publish.py`\n- `/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t05_report_files.py`</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>62193</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>6</tool_uses><duration_ms>91956</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}
