{"parentUuid":"dd4e4f25-c60f-46ed-8b63-ba2e82e98c4e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e1d94c1f-1dca-4964-bcba-d8bb8f4c124d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01LV7aGhcEZ4rYf3myuebmuE","type":"tool_result","content":"_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n\ncreate = _TABLE.create\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n\n\nclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` applies the same rule in its UPDATE.\"\"\"\n    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`. False if there is no\n    such Report; ReportLocked if it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user)):\n        return True\n    if get(report_id) is not None:\n        raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can edit a published Report.\")\n    return False\n\n\ndef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef _write_atomically(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace `path` in one step, so a failed write never leaves half a file.\"\"\"\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=\".part\")\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"wb\") as f:\n            f.write(data)\n        os.replace(tmp, path)\n    except BaseException:\n        Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n        raise\n\n\ndef _change_file(report_id: int, pdf: Pdf | None, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Attach `pdf`, or remove the file when it is None, under the lockdown\n    rule. The disk change happens inside the transaction that records it, so\n    a failed write rolls the row back, and a locked Report's file is never\n    touched.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        changed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n            (pdf.name if pdf else None, report_id, not is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n        if changed and pdf:\n            _write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n        elif changed:\n            file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    if changed:\n        return True\n    if get(report_id) is not None:\n        raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can change a published Report's file.\")\n    return False\n\n\ndef attach_file(report_id: int, pdf: Pdf, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Attach or replace the Report's file on behalf of `user`. False if there\n    is no such Report; ReportLocked if it is published and `user` is not a\n    Director.\"\"\"\n    return _change_file(report_id, pdf, user)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file, as attach_file.\"\"\"\n    return _change_file(report_id, None, user)\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report and its file. False if there is no such Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"8f3b04fc-b00b-49c0-a066-c28987ae3733","timestamp":"2026-09-28T22:38:33.121Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n\ncreate = _TABLE.create\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n\n\nclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` applies the same rule in its UPDATE.\"\"\"\n    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`. {"parentUuid":"39396656-2d08-471c-9108-960d9f9d143f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfWeBUsNkGJqiUi6XdR7h","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AYRcFa8hQxtNwZSrYcc61Q","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"gh issue comment 6 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings for T05, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review ran on the working tree against `4373158` (last T04 docs commit), on two axes in parallel: Standards and Spec.\n\n### Standards\nHard violations of `CLAUDE.md` constraints: none. Every new POST carries CSRF. Uploads live in `uploads/` (gitignored, outside `site/`). No new dependency: `python-multipart` was already in the stack. The Report forms use the glossary vocabulary.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| `download_file` returned 500 when `file_name` was set but the file was missing on disk | **Fixed**: now 404. Test: `test_a_file_missing_from_disk_is_404_not_a_crash` |\n| Removing a file unlinked it before the DB commit, so a failed commit could leave the row pointing at nothing | **Fixed**: unlink happens after commit (`reports.remove_file`) |\n| Body save and file attach ran in two transactions | **Fixed**: see Spec (c)1 |\n| Duplicated `get() is not None → ReportLocked` tail, and the route re-checked `can_edit` with a duplicated message on file removal | **Fixed**: one `_missing_or_locked` helper, and the removal route relies on `ReportLocked` |\n| `(status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)` fed `not is_director(user)` (double negative) | **Fixed** in the new `remove_file` (`OR ?` with `is_director`). `ContentTable.update`'s existing `drafts_only` was left as it is |\n| Shared `_content_fields.html` (also used by Data Bites) read Report-only names | **Fixed**: callers pass a `file_label`; the partial stays type-neutral |\n| Migration test rebuilt the old schema by string-replacing `db.SCHEMA` (brittle) | **Fixed**: hard-coded `PRE_T05_SCHEMA` |\n| Test helper `reports_file()` re-implements `reports.file_path` | **No change, deliberate**: the test states the expected location independently rather than asking the code |\n| Size cap is checked after `python-multipart` has spooled the whole request | **No change**: oversized files are never stored and get a clear error. The admin console is local-only (ADR-001), so there's no request-body limit. Noted as a known limit |\n| `ADDED_COLUMNS` migration list for one column (possible speculative generality) | **Kept**: without it an existing `cms.db` breaks on start (story 28) |\n| `attach_file`/`remove_file` as a middle man | **Resolved**: `attach_file` is gone; the file now travels with `create`/`update` |\n\n### Spec\nEvery ticket criterion is covered by code and tests.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| (c)1 An edit could half-save: body committed, then the file attach failed (disk error, or the Director publishing in between gave a 403 after the body was saved). Same on create | **Fixed**: `ContentTable.create/update` take an `also` callback that runs inside the row's transaction. The Report's file row and the disk write commit or roll back together, under the same lockdown `WHERE` as the body. Test: `test_a_failed_file_write_saves_nothing` |\n| (c)2 Missing file on disk gave 500 | **Fixed** (as above) |\n| (c)3 Size cap checked after the upload is received | **No change**: as above |\n| (c)4 PDF check requires `%PDF-` at byte 0 and `%%EOF` in the last 1 KB, which is stricter than some readers | **No change, deliberate**: strict is the safer default for an allowlist. Tested with a real macOS-generated PDF |\n| (a)1 The export tests can't fail yet because `render_site` writes no Report pages | **Deferred to T08 (#9)**: when export lands, tighten `test_a_draft_reports_file_never_appears_in_public_output` and `test_a_report_with_no_file_works_end_to_end` to assert on `reports/<slug>.html` and `reports/files/` |\n| (b)1 `GET /admin/reports/{id}/file` admin download wasn't asked for | **Kept**: it's the only way to check an upload before T07/T08. Login required, sent as an attachment with `nosniff` |\n| (b)2 Migration mechanism | Kept (above) |\n\n### Design notes\n- The storage path is `uploads/reports/<report_id>.pdf` and never uses the uploaded filename. The uploaded name is kept only as a sanitized display name (`reports.file_name`: ASCII letters, digits, `-`, `_`, max 100 characters, plus `.pdf`).\n- Validation order: extension and declared MIME, then size cap (20 MB), then content sniff. A rejected file saves nothing.\n\n### Verification\n- 133 CMS tests pass (34 new in `tests/test_t05_report_files.py`).\n- Mutation checks: turning off the content sniff, the lockdown, or the migration each makes the matching tests fail.\n- Smoke test: a real server ran against a copy of the local `cms.db` (the migration applied cleanly). A real PDF uploaded as `../../Smoke Factbook.pdf` was stored as `uploads/reports/1.pdf`, shown as `Smoke-Factbook.pdf`, and downloaded byte-identical. A fake PDF was rejected.\n- The only failures in the full suite are the 14 pre-existing `NotImplementedError` stubs in `test_ctx_guard.py` / `test_usage_report.py`, which predate this ticket.\nEOF\n)\" && gh issue view 6 --json comments --jq '.comments | length'","description":"Post code-review findings to issue #6"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":587,"cache_read_input_tokens":138794,"output_tokens":2069,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":587,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2069,"cache_read_input_tokens":138794,"cache_creation_input_tokens":587,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":587},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01AYRcFa8hQxtNwZSrYcc61Q":{"command":"cd /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && gh issue comment 6 --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings for T05, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review ran on the working tree against `4373158` (last T04 docs commit), on two axes in parallel: Standards and Spec.\n\n### Standards\nHard violations of `CLAUDE.md` constraints: none. {"parentUuid":"9a9a4dd0-14da-46ad-879f-585ab7c18bb0","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfWeDnvcmNpEUM5g9zhcN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T05 is done and committed as `eb5e1de` on `main`. I haven't pushed, so issue #6 will close when you push.\n\n**What you can do now:** attach an optional PDF to a Report when you create or edit it, replace it by uploading a new one, remove it with a \"Remove file\" button, or download it from the Report's edit page. The file follows the same rule as the body: an Analyst can only change it while the Report is a draft, and the Director can change it in any state.\n\n**Main decisions:**\n- **Storage:** files go in `uploads/reports/<report id>.pdf`, which is gitignored and outside `site/`. The name the uploader gave the file is never used in the path; it's cleaned up (letters, digits, `-` and `_` only) and kept just for display and as the download name.\n- **Checking the file:** the name must end in `.pdf`, the browser must say it's a PDF, it must be 20 MB or less, and the contents must actually look like a PDF. If any check fails, nothing is saved and the form shows a clear error.\n- **All or nothing:** the Report's text and its file are saved in one step. The review caught that an edit could previously save the text but lose the file if the upload failed.\n- **Your existing `cms.db`:** it gets the new column automatically the next time the server starts. I tested this on a copy of your database; the real one hasn't been touched.\n\n**Tests:**\n- All 133 CMS tests pass, 34 of them new for this ticket.\n- I disabled each key check in turn (the PDF content check, the draft/published rule, the database migration) and confirmed the matching tests fail.\n- A real server test with a genuine PDF worked: upload, clean display name, byte-identical download. A fake PDF was rejected.\n- The full suite has the same 14 failures as before I started. They're all unfinished course-tooling tests (`tests/test_ctx_guard.py`, `tests/test_usage_report.py`), not the CMS.\n\n**Code review:** I posted the findings and how each was handled on issue #6. What's left open:\n- **Size limit:** a file over 20 MB is fully received before it's rejected.
